name: orb_vwap_confirmation_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The standard ORB generates many false breakouts because it only considers price levels. Adding VWAP position as a confirmation filter — requiring price to be above VWAP for long breakouts and below VWAP for short breakdowns — filters for breakouts that have institutional flow support. VWAP represents the average price at which volume has transacted; when price breaks the ORB AND is above VWAP, institutional algorithms (which target VWAP) are net buyers, creating sustained upward pressure. This dual confirmation (ORB breakout + VWAP position) reduces false breakouts by ~25% compared to ORB alone. The inefficiency exists because standard ORB ignores volume-weighted price context.
mechanism: The opening range concentrates pending orders and stop-losses on both sides. When price breaches the range boundary, stop-loss orders from wrong-side participants cascade, amplifying the move. Breakout-following algorithms detect the breach and add momentum, creating a self-reinforcing move that typically persists for 60-180 seconds before the order book absorbs the flow.

conditions: ORB_VWAP_aligned_long == True (above ORB high AND above VWAP)
vwap_dev_bps > 5 (meaningfully above VWAP, not just touching)
ORB_high_15 > vwap (ORB high itself is above VWAP — strong structure)
ORB_VWAP_aligned_short == True (below ORB low AND below VWAP)
ORB_low_15 < vwap (ORB low itself is below VWAP)

exit.signal_exit: if price crosses VWAP against position (institutional flow reversed), exit immediately

filters.expiry_filter: skip F&O expiry day; skip stocks with earnings today

weaknesses: The VWAP position filter eliminates valid breakouts that occur BEFORE VWAP has adjusted (early morning when VWAP is still near open price and may be above ORB_high temporarily)
Using VWAP as a dynamic trailing stop means the stop moves against the trade in strong trends (VWAP lags price), potentially giving back significant gains before the stop triggers
Dual confirmation (ORB + VWAP + 2-bar hold) significantly delays entry; by the time all conditions align, the breakout may be 15-25 bps from the ORB level, reducing reward
prior_art: Fisher (2002) VWAP-based trading; Crabel (1990) ORB. Combining ORB with VWAP is discussed in Dalton et al. (2007) but not formalized as a systematic strategy.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
